title: scene-00: region destroy sends bogus VTCCall StateChange
description: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md:1119 SHOULD deliver a StateChange for VTCCall when a region with activeCallId is destroyed. The VTCCall did not change, so its state string does not move and the notification is meaningless. Either give VTCCall a back-reference that changes, or drop the requirement.
